title: Astral Font
pages: Craft the Astral Font early from four quartz, two amethyst shards, glass, a copper ingot and an iron ingot. Place it beneath open sky before the first Kiln. At night it gathers five lumen every second, up to 1,000. It does not accept FE and industrial machinery cannot generate lumen.

Adjacent fonts exchange up to four lumen every five ticks, flowing from the fuller font to the emptier one. A covered font can therefore receive lumen from an outdoor font; loaded chunks are required.

Offering Ring: surround one Astral Font at its own height with four gold blocks on the north, south, east and west sides and four amethyst blocks on the diagonals. Power the font with redstone, for example a redstone block directly beneath it, and drop amethyst shards onto its top. Every four seconds the formed, powered ring consumes one shard for 160 lumen, even in daylight. It pauses if fewer than 160 lumen fit in the 1,000-lumen store; no offering is wasted. A downward-facing dropper above the font can feed shards automatically, and adjacent fonts above or below can carry the result onward. The ring never accepts FE or industrial energy. Break one frame block or remove redstone power to stop it; loose offerings can still despawn normally.

Pedestal rites use the same powered gold-amethyst ring as shard offerings. Place one item on top of each of the four diagonal amethyst blocks, then drop the center ingredient on the font. Every four seconds, if at least the listed lumen is stored, the font consumes exactly one item at each position and drops the result above itself. The ring must stay formed and redstone-powered. Two starting recipes: an echo shard plus four sculk and 300 lumen make a sculk sensor; a prismarine crystal plus four prismarine shards and 220 lumen make a sea lantern. Neither rite adds traits absent from its inputs. Droppers aimed at each pedestal and the center can feed it; collect the output with a hopper minecart or other item collector. Data packs can add arcana_industry:pedestal_rite recipes with center, corner, lumen_cost and result fields. Matching recipes resolve by alphabetically first ID. Keep the center clear when feeding to prevent stray items blocking a rite.

Sacrificial pedestal rite: with the powered ring formed, put one echo shard on the Font and one sculk vein on each diagonal pedestal. Bring a living zombie within one block of the Font at item height. At the next four-second check, 360 lumen, one of each item, and the zombie are consumed to make a sculk catalyst. The zombie is removed without ordinary loot or experience. A missing zombie or insufficient lumen leaves all offerings and the mob intact. Keep the ritual contained: a powered ring will consume any matching zombie in its center, including one led there by another player. JEI lists the required mob. Data packs may set an optional sacrifice entity ID on pedestal_rite recipes; missing IDs mean no mob is needed. An item collector can take the catalyst.

Use an empty hand on a font holding at least 100 lumen to gain 30 seconds of night vision. The action spends 100 lumen. Breaking a font drops the block, while stored lumen is lost; place it before nightfall. A font with 100+ lumen on a Concordance Altar diagonal corner adds 2 altar stability and pays 100 lumen per fusion that needs it.

Hold an item the font recognizes and use it on the font to perform a lumen rite: the font consumes the held item and lumen, then gives you the result (dropping it if your inventory is full). A font too low on lumen refuses the rite and keeps the item. Data packs add rites with the arcana_industry:lumen_rite recipe type. A successful rite sounds a rising three-note glass tone; silence with the same held item means no rite fired.

Known rites: 8 feathers + 150 lumen yield 1 phantom membrane; 8 sculk + 220 lumen yield 1 echo shard; 4 rotten flesh + 60 lumen yield 1 leather; 1 glow ink sac + 40 lumen yields 2 glowstone dust; 6 glow berries + 50 lumen yield 1 glowstone dust. A rite only concentrates what its offering already holds (see Material Traits), so it never turns one metal into another. When several rites accept the held stack, the rite with the alphabetically first recipe ID is performed. Rites can also run unattended in a rite basin (see the last page).

More rites: 5 string + 60 lumen yield 1 cobweb; 6 honeycomb + 60 lumen yield 2 honey bottles; 6 gunpowder + 80 lumen yield 3 fire charges; 4 spider eyes + 90 lumen yield 2 fermented spider eyes; 5 leather + 120 lumen yield 1 saddle; 8 prismarine shards + 120 lumen yield 4 prismarine crystals; 8 feathers + 150 lumen yield 1 phantom membrane.

Concentration rites: 4 magma cream + 140 lumen yield 2 blaze powder; 5 turtle scutes + 160 lumen yield 1 nautilus shell; 6 prismarine crystals + 180 lumen yield 1 sea lantern; 6 rabbit hide + 180 lumen yield 1 rabbit's foot; 3 blaze powder + 200 lumen yield 1 blaze rod; 2 echo shards + 240 lumen yield 1 sculk sensor; 8 popped chorus fruit + 260 lumen yield 1 shulker shell; 2 amethyst blocks (crafted from 8 shards) + 400 lumen yield 1 budding amethyst; 8 nautilus shells + 480 lumen yield 1 heart of the sea. Lumen powers a rite but adds no property: the product may only hold material traits that the offered stack carries (see Material Traits). The font refuses any rite, including a data-pack rite of the arcana_industry:lumen_rite type, whose product would invent a trait, and spends nothing.

Early progression rite: use one amethyst shard on a font holding at least 40 lumen to form a Night Sigil. The Kiln craft consumes one sigil; wait for night, keep the font sky-exposed, and perform the rite before attempting the thermal workshop. No industrial recipe creates the sigil.

Pressing-tier rite: once the Kiln fires Annealed Copper, use two of them on a font holding at least 80 lumen to form a Temper Glyph. The Pressure Press craft consumes one glyph in its top-right slot. Automation can stock the copper, but the rite itself is performed at the font and no industrial recipe creates the glyph.

Aqueous-tier rite: once the Pressure Press makes Sealed Steel Plates, use one on a font holding at least 120 lumen to form a Brine Ward. The Leaching Vat craft consumes one ward in its bottom-center slot. Automation can stock the plates, but the rite is performed at the font and no industrial recipe creates the ward.

Electrical-tier rite: once the Leaching Vat yields Purified Salts, offer two to a font holding at least 160 lumen to form an Ion Seal. The Electrolyzer craft consumes one seal in its bottom-left slot. Salts can be piped in by automation, but the seal only comes from the font rite; no machine recipe makes it.

Resonant-tier rite: after the Electrolyzer makes Conductive Crystals, offer two to a font holding at least 200 lumen to form a Resonant Rune. The Resonance Infuser craft consumes one rune in its middle-right slot as well as a separate conductive crystal. This rite must be performed at the font; machines cannot create the rune.

Solar-tier rite: once the Resonance Infuser attunes quartz, offer two Attuned Quartz to a font holding at least 240 lumen to form a Dawn Emblem. The Heliostat Etcher craft consumes one emblem in its bottom-left slot in addition to its own attuned quartz slot. Perform it at night or bank lumen through adjacent fonts; machines cannot create the emblem.

Prismatic-tier rite: after the Heliostat Etcher makes Solar Prisms, offer two to a font with at least 280 lumen to make a Prism Mandala. The Prism Separator craft consumes one mandala in its bottom-left slot and a separate Solar Prism. The rite is performed at the font; automation can stock the prisms but cannot create the mandala.

Lattice-tier rite: after the Prism Separator yields Prism Cores, offer two to a font with at least 320 lumen to make a Core Halo. The Lattice Composer craft consumes one halo in its bottom-left slot and a separate Prism Core. The rite is performed at the font; automation can stock the cores but cannot create the halo.

Phase-tier rite: after the Lattice Composer makes Phase Lattice, offer two to a font with at least 360 lumen to make a Phase Sigil. The Phase Annealer craft consumes one sigil in its bottom-right slot and a separate phase lattice. A single night yields up to 1,000 lumen, so bank the cost through adjacent fonts if needed. Machines cannot create the sigil.

Capstone rite: after the Phase Conflux yields Converged Phase, offer two to a font with at least 480 lumen to make a Phase Heart. The Phase Scepter craft consumes one heart in its top-center slot. Converged Phase needs the whole Modulator, Stabilizer, Preserver, Effuser and Conflux line, so the heart is the last font rite of the t9 phase tier; no machine creates it.

Rite basin automation: without the gold-amethyst ring, power a font with redstone (a lever or redstone block beside it) and place a hopper, chest or other item container directly beneath it. Every four seconds the font checks the items resting on its top, adds up identical dropped stacks, and performs one hand-rite recipe from the list above, including the tier rites. The rite spends the same lumen and offerings and inserts the result into the container below. It waits without consuming anything if lumen is short, power is off, nothing is below, or the full result does not fit. A downward dropper above the font can feed offerings. The font itself still has no item or FE interface, and only night sky or ring offerings refill its lumen.
